scenes.text: Here's what Claude just did in your session, and three ideas worth knowing.
One: a sliding window. Count each client's requests in the last sixty seconds. The window moves with the clock, so there's no reset to burst through.
Two: limit by IP and by user. IP stops one machine trying many accounts. User stops one account hit from many machines.
Three: over the limit, the server replies four twenty-nine, Too Many Requests, with a Retry-After header saying when to come back.
Three small ideas. Your API just got a lot harder to abuse.
